cards.title: Programmatic Tool Calling Beats JSON in 11/14 Models on BFCL v4
cards.why_it_matters: If you're building LLM agents with tool use, this is direct empirical guidance on whether to expose tools as typed Python stubs vs. JSON schemas — with real benchmark numbers across 14 models.
cards.summary: Across 14 LLMs on BFCL v4, programmatic tool calling (PTC) — exposing tools as typed Python stubs executed in a single agent turn — matches or exceeds native JSON tool calling in 11 of 14 models. GPT family gains 10.6% over JSON baseline. PTC outperforms in 13/14 models under parallel fan-out and remains stable where JSON degrades ~2.3% under context rot.
